title: The Big Ethereum Trivia Quiz
description:
An interactive quiz with Ethereum trivia-themed questions.
We will ask a wide variety of questions ranging from guessing memes, old logos, gas pricing, EIP history, significant dates, devcon locations etc.
The quiz will be designed to serve as a fun challenge for competitive people, a nice trip down memory lane for those who've been around for a while, and an interesting history lesson for those who are new to Ethereum.

Comment:
We're requesting a workshop slot, since it will take longer than 25 minutes, but we would be open to do this on a bigger stage too if possible, since people just need a browser to participate and a smartphone is sufficient.
